title: On the inclusion of bounded harmonic functions of random walks
summary: We investigate the conditions under which the space of bounded harmonic functions of a probability measure $μ$ on a group $G$ is contained in that of another measure $θ$. We establish that asymptotic commutativity, defined by the condition $\|μ^{*t}*θ- θ*μ^{*t}\|_{TV} \to 0$ as $t \to \infty$, is sufficient to guarantee the inclusion $H^\infty(G, μ) \subseteq H^\infty(G, θ)$, provided $θ$ is absolutely continuous with respect to a convex combination of convolution powers of $μ$.
